def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Input validation
    # Check tau_filter is not boolean
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    # Check tau_filter is finite and nonnegative
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Check each array is a 2D matrix
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")

    # Check shapes match
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")

    # Compute per-candidate sums along horizon
    sum_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    sum_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    sum_no = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Margin relative to no-call (negative loss reduction is positive margin)
    # margin = L_no_call - L_with_result = sum_with - sum_no
    margin = sum_with - sum_no

    # Also need margin relative to call-only for filtering
    # L_call_only - L_with_result = sum_with - sum_call
    margin_call = sum_with - sum_call

    # Keep if both margins exceed tau (strictly greater)
    keep_mask = (margin > tau_filter) & (margin_call > tau_filter)

    # Ensure margins are finite (they should be)
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(margin)):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected non-finite margin")

    return keep_mask, margin
